field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: True because this is the FR-11 memory task.
field_principles.contradiction_rate: Fraction of motif groups with conflicting final correctness labels.
field_principles.duplicate_rate: Fraction of buffered events repeating an already-seen motif key.
field_principles.duration_s: Real wall-clock duration; no sleep padding.
field_principles.eager_consolidations_avoided: Per-event eager consolidation calls not made.
field_principles.forgetting_regression_count: Rows whose final energy or correctness regressed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete:/blocked_ verdict; no inferred live success.
field_principles.live_llm_called: False because summaries are deterministic metadata strings.
field_principles.memory_hash_after: Hash of prior replay memory plus the Exp 2881 memory file after write.
field_principles.memory_hash_before: Hash of prior replay memory plus the Exp 2881 memory file before write.
field_principles.n_consolidations_triggered: Clusters actually written into the consolidated memory state.
field_principles.n_events_ingested: Events accepted into the subconscious buffer before any consolidation.
field_principles.n_recurrence_clusters: Sustained failure-motif clusters detected before drift gating.
field_principles.recmem_trigger_ready: True only when recurrence support exists and drift guards report no contradiction or forgetting regression.
field_principles.recurrence_threshold: Feature-similarity threshold used by the recurrence detector.
field_principles.source_artifacts: Existing offline replay artifacts loaded before consolidation.
field_principles.token_reduction_proxy_pct: Deterministic byte/token-like proxy reduction vs eager writes.

methodology_note: Blocked before RecMem consolidation; no metrics were inferred.
